answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: Median first divergence is 3.5 and edit distance 0.613, which fits fine-tuned (5.5-8, 0.56-0.65) better than quantized (10-17) and is far from system-prompted (0, 0.79-0.82). Logit changes are moderate: KL 0.124, top-1 agreement 0.939, TV 0.076. Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.086 and layer 16 is 0.162, both at the low end of fine-tuned, with layer 32 at 0.297 and a small layer-2 spike of 1.2. The mid-layer size ratio is 1.018 (grows), which matches fine-tuned (1.017-1.023); quantized shrinks to 0.968. Direction consistency is 0.625 (fine-tuned 0.618-0.705; quantized 0.513). Refusals dropped 3 of 64, also consistent with fine-tuned. Quantized and system-prompted are ruled out by these values.
